processes.name: Service Request Intake & Dispatch
processes.description: Customers submit service requests via a website form or phone call; office staff log them on paper tickets and route urgent cases to an answering service for after-hours emergencies.
pain_points: Manual data entry from web form to paper tickets
Risk of lost or misrouted emergency calls
No automated routing to available technicians

processes.name: Scheduling & Dispatch Management
processes.description: Office staff use a physical whiteboard and spreadsheet to assign jobs, prioritize Comfort Club members, and manage same-day or after-hours emergency calls across 14 technicians.
pain_points: Whiteboard visibility limits for remote or off-site staff
Spreadsheet version control and manual updates
Difficulty balancing priority members with emergency requests

processes.name: Field Repair & Maintenance Execution
processes.description: Licensed technicians visit residential and commercial sites to diagnose, repair, or maintain HVAC systems including furnaces, heat pumps, central ACs, and ductless mini-splits.
pain_points: Travel time between suburban job sites
Manual parts tracking on paper tickets
Inconsistent documentation of completed work and warranties

processes.name: System Replacement & Installation Project Management
processes.description: Comfort Advisors conduct home assessments, perform load calculations, provide written replacement options, and coordinate two install crews to replace approximately 300 home systems annually.
pain_points: Coordination friction between advisors and install crews

processes.name: Membership Plan Administration (Comfort Club)
processes.description: Manage 600+ annual subscribers for $189, schedule bi-annual tune-ups (spring cooling, fall heating), apply priority scheduling, and waive overtime charges for members.
pain_points: Scheduling conflicts between priority members and regular jobs
Manual calculation and application of overtime waivers

processes.name: Commercial Account & Preventive Maintenance Management
processes.description: Manage preventive maintenance agreements and rooftop unit (RTU) service/replacement for approximately 90 commercial buildings, including offices, retail centers, churches, and schools.
pain_points: Tracking service history across 90 diverse commercial sites
Manual contract renewal and billing tracking
Coordinating specialized commercial technicians with residential schedules
